_note: PEP-OWNED capture-time policy, keyed by the release's logical component. It defines ONLY the component/package identity policy the capture stage checks: which runtime package names are certifiable for a component, and any expected binary version. It is NOT the set of platforms/OS/arch/PG versions PEP can execute. Detector evidence says what was BUILT; the later coordinator forms the execution set by INTERSECTING those built cells with PEP's own execution catalog. This file never carries a caller-owned platform list or a fixed target universe. It is the seed of the future centralized PEP policy source; today it carries only the capture-smoke fixture component.
